risk_summary: The disclosure provides substantial quantitative detail on revenue, margins, expenses, acquisition costs, and contractual commitments, but includes extensive standard forward-looking disclaimers and uncertainty around COVID-19 and cost inflation. Risk tone is mildly negative because operating income fell sharply, gross margins compressed, and paver-line start-up and input-cost pressures affected performance, although infrastructure spending and operational initiatives provide supportive factors.
